mnemonic.meaning: Cooperate (協) and discuss (議). A conference, discussion.
mnemonic.reading: KYO, GEE (きょうぎ): in Kyoto, gee, the conference never ends. Same sound as 競技 (competition).

examples.ja: 双方が協議を続けている。
examples.en: Both sides are continuing their discussions.

items.note: Formal talks. 話し合い is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Rules (規) to control (制). A regulation.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, SAY (きせい): "The key regulation," they say, "is no smoking."

examples.ja: 交通規制が行われている。
examples.en: Traffic restrictions are in place.

items.note: Rules imposed from above. 規則 (きそく) = a rule.

mnemonic.meaning: 繋 has 糸 (thread): thread ties things together. To connect.
mnemonic.reading: TUNA, GAY RUE (つなげる): you connect the tuna to the line.

examples.ja: 二つの線を繋げた。
examples.en: I connected the two wires.

items.note: Close to 繋ぐ (つなぐ). Usually in kana: つなげる. Intransitive: 繋がる.

mnemonic.meaning: The scenery (景) and air (気) of the market. The economy.
mnemonic.reading: CAKE, KEY (けいき): when the economy's good, everyone buys cake.

examples.ja: 最近、景気が良くなってきた。
examples.en: The economy has been picking up lately.

items.note: 景気がいい = business is booming. 不景気 = recession.

mnemonic.meaning: 寮 has 宀 (roof): a roof over many students. A dormitory.
mnemonic.reading: RYO (りょう): Ryo lives in the dorm.

examples.ja: 大学の寮に住んでいる。
examples.en: I live in the university dorm.

items.note: 社員寮 = company housing for employees.

mnemonic.meaning: 基 is base: built on a base. Based on.
mnemonic.reading: MOTO, ZOO, KOO (もとづく): the new zoo is based on the old plan. もと is the base (基), as in 基本.

examples.ja: この映画は実話に基づいている。
examples.en: This film is based on a true story.

items.note: Usually 〜に基づいて / 基づく. Formal.

mnemonic.meaning: A pair (双) of children (子). Twins.
mnemonic.reading: FOO, TAG, GO (ふたご): the twins play tag. Go!

examples.ja: あの二人は双子だ。
examples.en: Those two are twins.

items.note: 双子座 = Gemini.

mnemonic.meaning: 祭 has 示 (altar): offerings at the altar, a festival.
mnemonic.reading: MATS, REE (まつり): you roll out mats for the festival.

examples.ja: 夏祭りに浴衣で行った。
examples.en: I went to the summer festival in a yukata.

items.note: Usually written 祭り. お祭り is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Fly (飛) and go (行). Flight, flying.
mnemonic.reading: HE, COKE (ひこう): he drinks a Coke during the flight.

examples.ja: 飛行中は席を立たないでください。
examples.en: Please stay seated during the flight.

items.note: 飛行機 = airplane. 飛行場 = airfield.

mnemonic.meaning: 討 has 言 (words): words of attack. To attack, avenge.
mnemonic.reading: OOTS (うつ)! You attack the enemy. Same sound as 打つ (hit).

examples.ja: 主人公は父の敵を討った。
examples.en: The hero avenged his father.

items.note: Old-fashioned, from stories: 敵を討つ (take revenge).

mnemonic.meaning: 課 has 言 (words): words that assign. A section, a lesson.
mnemonic.reading: CAR (か): the car section of the company.

examples.ja: 彼は営業課で働いている。
examples.en: He works in the sales section.

items.note: A section in a company: 課長 (section chief). Also a textbook lesson: 第三課.

mnemonic.meaning: SUE, TECHY (すてき): Sue's techy new dress is lovely, wonderful.

examples.ja: すてきな服ですね。
examples.en: That's a lovely outfit.

items.note: Kanji: 素敵. Often used for charming things and people.

mnemonic.meaning: Each piece (片) attached (付け) to its place. Tidying up.
mnemonic.reading: KATA, ZOO, KAY (かたづけ): tidying up the zoo, OK.

examples.ja: パーティーの後の片付けを手伝った。
examples.en: I helped clean up after the party.

items.note: 後片付け = clearing up afterwards.

mnemonic.meaning: 缶 looks like a can.
mnemonic.reading: CAN (かん): a can, same as in English.

examples.ja: 空き缶を拾った。
examples.en: I picked up the empty cans.

items.note: 缶ジュース = canned juice. 缶詰 = canned food.

mnemonic.meaning: The manner (様) of doing (仕). A specification, a method.
mnemonic.reading: SHE, YO (しよう): "She, yo, reads the specs."

examples.ja: この携帯の仕様を確認した。
examples.en: I checked the specs of this phone.

items.note: Tech specs. 仕様がない (しようがない; in speech しょうがない) = it can't be helped.

mnemonic.meaning: 兎 looks like a rabbit with long ears and a tail. A rabbit.
mnemonic.reading: OOH, SAG, EE (うさぎ): the rabbit's ears sag.

examples.ja: 庭に兎がいる。
examples.en: There's a rabbit in the garden.

items.note: Usually written ウサギ or うさぎ.

mnemonic.meaning: Roll (転) to a new school (校). Changing schools.
mnemonic.reading: TEN, COKE (てんこう): you change schools ten times and drink ten Cokes.

examples.ja: 父の仕事で転校した。
examples.en: I changed schools because of my father's job.

items.note: 転校生 = transfer student.

mnemonic.meaning: A purified (斎) room for writing (書). A study.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW, SIGH (しょさい): you sigh in your quiet study.

examples.ja: 父は書斎で本を読んでいる。
examples.en: My father is reading in his study.

items.note: A private room for reading and writing at home.

mnemonic.meaning: "OOH, NAH, RUE (うなる)!" The bear groans, moans and growls.

examples.ja: 犬がうなって、こちらをにらんだ。
examples.en: The dog growled and glared at us.

items.note: Also for engines and people impressed: 観客をうならせる (impress the audience). Kanji: 唸る.

mnemonic.meaning: Feathers (羽) at the root (根). A feather, a wing.
mnemonic.reading: HA, NEH (はね): "Ha!" The bird drops a feather.

examples.ja: 床に鳥の羽根が落ちていた。
examples.en: There was a bird's feather on the floor.

items.note: Also blades of a fan, or a shuttlecock. Often just 羽.

mnemonic.meaning: The logic (理) of things (物). Physics.
mnemonic.reading: BOOTS, REE (ぶつり): physics: your boots fall to the ground.

examples.ja: 物理の試験は難しかった。
examples.en: The physics exam was hard.

items.note: 物理学 = physics. 物理的 = physical.

mnemonic.meaning: Descend (降) and bow down (伏). Surrender.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, FOO, COO (こうふく): the pigeon surrenders the Coke. Same sound as 幸福 (happiness).

examples.ja: 敵は降伏した。
examples.en: The enemy surrendered.

items.note: Military or formal. Everyday: 負けを認める.

mnemonic.meaning: 治 is govern: to rule, to settle.
mnemonic.reading: OSAMA, RUE (おさめる): Osama the king rules and rues.

examples.ja: 王は長い間その国を治めた。
examples.en: The king ruled that country for a long time.

items.note: 治める = govern or calm. 収める / 納める / 修める are other おさめる verbs.

mnemonic.meaning: Reach (至) the extreme of hurry (急). Urgent.
mnemonic.reading: SHE, CUE (しきゅう): she needs it immediately, on cue.

examples.ja: 至急連絡してください。
examples.en: Please contact us immediately.

items.note: Business: 大至急 = extremely urgent.

mnemonic.meaning: Advance (進) in study (学). Going on to higher education.
mnemonic.reading: SHIN, GACK (しんがく): you go to college and kick your shin. GACK!

examples.ja: 大学に進学するつもりだ。
examples.en: I plan to go on to university.

items.note: Moving up to the next level of school. 入学 = entering a school.

mnemonic.meaning: 殻 has 殳 (weapon): a hard shell that protects. A husk.
mnemonic.reading: CARA (から): caramel coats the nut shell. Same sound as 空 (empty).

examples.ja: 卵の殻を割った。
examples.en: I cracked the egg's shell.

items.note: 殻に閉じこもる = to retreat into your shell.

mnemonic.meaning: Study (学) of wisdom (哲). Philosophy.
mnemonic.reading: TET, SUE, GACK (てつがく): Tet and Sue study philosophy. GACK!

examples.ja: 大学で哲学を勉強した。
examples.en: I studied philosophy at university.

items.note: Also a personal philosophy: 人生哲学.

mnemonic.meaning: See (見) and dance (舞) for someone sick. A visit to the hospital.
mnemonic.reading: ME, MY (みまい): "Me, my friend!" You visit your sick friend.

examples.ja: 入院中の友達のお見舞いに行った。
examples.en: I visited a friend in hospital.

items.note: Usually お見舞い. Also a get-well gift or card.

mnemonic.meaning: Compete (競) with skill (技). A competition, a sporting event.
mnemonic.reading: KYO, GEE (きょうぎ): in Kyoto, gee, the sports competition is huge. Same sound as 協議 (discussion).

examples.ja: 陸上競技が好きだ。
examples.en: I like track and field events.

items.note: A sporting event or contest. 試合 = a match.

mnemonic.meaning: Provisions (糧) to eat (食). Staple foods.
mnemonic.reading: SHOCK, RYO (しょくりょう): Ryo is shocked: the provisions ran out. Same sound as 食料.

examples.ja: 世界の食糧問題を考える。
examples.en: We think about the world food problem.

items.note: 食糧 = staple foods like grain, often in big-picture issues. 食料 = food in general.
